description: Synthetic two-speaker interview generated locally with Windows text-to-speech (no real person's voice). Used to measure transcription accuracy, speaker attribution and latency against the real Deepgram API. gapMs is the silence before the line; a negative gap overlaps the previous line.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, thanks for joining us today. Can you hear me clearly?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I can hear you fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. Let's start with something technical. What is the difference between a process and a thread?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A process has its own memory space, while threads share memory inside a single process.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how would you design a rate limiter for a public API?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I would use a token bucket for each client and keep the counters in Redis.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Should I go into more detail about the trade offs?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, that's fine. Tell me about a project where you handled a large transaction volume.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At my last company I built a payment service that handled millions of transactions every day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you, that's all from my side.
